hooks.name: Block Custom CSS Changes
hooks.description: Prevents any modifications to CSS files, enforcing the project rule that all styling must use daisyUI and Tailwind utility classes exclusively.

action.prompt: STOP — check if this write operation targets a CSS file (*.css). If it does, DO NOT proceed. Custom CSS is strictly forbidden in this project. All styling must use daisyUI component classes and Tailwind CSS utility classes only. Refactor the approach to use inline Tailwind/daisyUI classes instead. If you're adding animations, use Tailwind's animate-* utilities or daisyUI's loading components. If you're adding hover effects, use Tailwind's hover: prefix. Never append to or modify style.css.
